messages:
maya: quick sync 1 exploring two approaches for the playground streaming indicator: a subtle pulse next to avatar vs compact token pill on the right. attaching quick mock: https://img.redwood.dev/tmp/pulse-vs-pill (mock)
jon: pulse feels lighter but might hide token totals. pill makes counts discoverable. tradeoff: cognitive load vs info density.
sam: engineering constraints: pill easier for clicking (expand) and keyboard focus. pulse is purely decorative, would still need a separate token area for exact counts.
alisha: accessibility: decorative pulses must not be announced. if we use pulse + hidden token region, ensure token region is reachable via keyboard and has aria-live for updates. contrast on the pill must be >=4.5:1.
maya: proposal: default UI uses pulse + minimal pill (icon + rounded count like 1.2k). clicking or keyboard focusing the pill expands a detailed panel with exact token breakdown and cache badge. expansion is instant; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
jon: for stop/regenerate UX: do we keep separate buttons or a contextual action? my vote: persistent stop during streaming, persistent regenerate when idle. collapsing them into a single primary toggler confuses discoverability.
maya: agree on persistent separate actions, but keep them compact and stacked in a micro-menu on small screens: [Stop] [...more] where more contains Regenerate / Copy / Share.
sam: runtime events available: streaming.progress, streaming.finished, token.metrics. we can debounce token updates to 300ms for UI and only send aria announcements on debounced values. keyboard mapping: Esc to stop, R to regenerate, with modifier reminder in tooltip.
ulx-snippet: ```js
// stop handler
doc.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && streamActive) stopStream(); if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r' && !streamActive && (e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)) regen(); });
```
alisha: aria notes: use role=status for update region, aria-live=polite, and announce when generation ends with a short message like "Generation complete, response ready." Avoid per-token SR announcements by debouncing. add focusable control to open token details for screen-reader users.
jon: token formatting: compact uses SI-ish rounded counts (1.2k), expanded shows exact integer. include hover tooltip explaining rounding and what counts are included.
maya: prompt library microcopy: rename "My prompts" -> "Workspace prompts" and change empty-state copy to "Save prompts here for your team. Click the star on a prompt to pin it." This clarifies ownership for orgs.
sam: layout debate: prompt drawer as bottom sheet vs right rail. bottom sheet is great on mobile but clutters small laptops. keep right rail as default for desktop, bottom sheet for widths <900px.
alisha: keyboard accessibility: ensure prompt drawer trap focus when open, ESC closes, and list items are arrow-key navigable. screen reader heading announced on open.
maya: motion: keep shimmer to a 250-350ms initial window only; after that show token delta updates. respect reduced-motion and appears instantly otherwise.
sam: telemetry: add events ui.token_pill_clicked, ui.promptdrawer_opened, ui.stop_clicked. include context labels for mobile/desktop.
jon: tiny copy nit: change button label from "Stop generation" to "Stop" and tooltip "Stop generation (Esc)". shorter label reduces wrap in small widths.
alisha: file a11y ticket for pill contrast, focus outline, and screen-reader announcements. also add test cases for NVDA/VoiceOver with fast token updates.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll assemble a 1-pager with final comps and keyboard spec by COB today. can eng estimate slot next sprint after that?
sam: yes, if we get spec by 5pm PT we can scope it for next sprint.
ux-bot: heads-up: please attach color tokens and keyboard sequence examples to the spec so QA can start writing a11y tests.
